My Career Training adapts the observation builders to its normalized RLBot v5
packet boundary and preserves upstream observation math. This implementation
uses the original licensed source, rather than the separate unlicensed v5 port.
The original model weights are unchanged. The models and their adapted code
are a separate licensed component; the app MIT license does not relicense them.
No commercial permission or competitive rank certification is claimed.
